# Read Primitives — MAX_BY Simple

```{tags} reference, query-template, read_primitives
```

> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

Find the customer with the highest account balance in each nation

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    n.n_name,
    c.c_name,
    c.c_acctbal,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC, c.c_name) AS rn
  FROM customer AS c
  JOIN nation AS n
    ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
)
SELECT
  n_name,
  c_name AS richest_customer,
  c_acctbal AS max_balance
FROM ranked
WHERE
  rn = 1
ORDER BY
  max_balance DESC,
  n_name
```
